rule:
- If left_last is NUM and right_first is a measurement/unit token, move the marker into a lower target band (roughly 10–50) instead of applying the usual strong upward boost. This reduces misplaced preference for splitting numerals from their units or coordinated numerals.
- When left_last is a short name/org token, reduce the size of the upward bias (target band ~10–50) instead of treating the position as top-tier. Many such cuts split a name/appositive from its continuing clause and the remainder often overturns or degrades the left-side measurement.
